description: Change fields of your own listing, with the same rules as the edit form on voxelrank.com. Send only the fields to change. Text is checked for abuse and an invite link is checked with Discord, so a save can be refused with a reason. Address, game, Votifier and plugin settings can only be changed on the website. Needs your listing's API key.

country.description: Two-letter country code where the server is hosted, e.g. "DE".

description.description: Full description, 30-6000 characters. Plain text with line breaks.

discord.description: Discord invite link (discord.gg/... or your own link that redirects to one). Empty string removes it.

languages.description: Language codes spoken on the server, main one first, e.g. ["en", "de"]. Replaces the old list.

rewards_text.description: What voters get, shown on the vote page. Up to 1000 characters.

server.description: Optional. Your listing's id or slug. Defaults to the listing the API key belongs to; any other listing is refused.

store_url.description: Store link, starting with https://. Empty string removes it.

tagline.description: One-line pitch shown under the name, up to 90 characters.

tags.description: The full new tag list from this game's tags (list_games with game). Replaces the old list.

website.description: Your website, starting with https:// or http://. Empty string removes it.

wiki_url.description: Wiki link, starting with https://. Empty string removes it.

name: update_server
title: Update my server
